All 427 stories on this origin render; this file keeps the stories of the components @carbon/styles ships, because the rest (data grid, spreadsheet, the deprecated set) render classes Design cannot compile. components-tearsheet-* and deprecated-coachmark-* are left out deliberately: they are the generation before the one @carbon/styles ships and reuse its class names on a different structure.
_meta.generations: ibm-products names a rewritten component with a __next segment while the old one ships beside it: c4p--tearsheet__next__header, c4p--coachmark__next--content-header. @carbon/styles ships the rewrite under the plain name (tearsheet__header, coachmark--content-header). tools/lib/capture-names.mjs drops the segment when a check reads this file; the capture keeps what was rendered.
_meta.versionNote: This origin has no single Carbon version, so carbonVersion is not written. @carbon/ibm-products 2.99.0 is the release the Storybook welcome page names; the rest are read from /project.json on the same origin (knownPackages.uiLibraryPackages). They are ranges, because that is what ibm-products declares, and carbonStyles ^1.114.0 is below the 1.116.0 this repository compiles, so a cds-- difference between this file and carbon-react-*.json can be Carbon moving.
_meta.settle: SETTLE_MIN_MS 6000, SETTLE_MAX_MS 15000, CONCURRENCY 2; 68 of 68 usable. Components here measure themselves before they finish rendering: c4p--truncated-text renders its tooltip trigger only after measuring its overflow, and c4p--tag-overflow hides every tag until it has measured the row. Both need the browser to draw frames, and a tab in a hidden window draws none, so a harvest there records the first frame and reports no failure. This capture was taken with frames forced; tag-overflow__tag-container in all eight tag-overflow stories is the sign it worked.
